ns2:course.label: Field Practicum
ns2:course.description: Field practicum is the final semester of the student's senior year. Students participate in field experiences for 16 weeks, 4 days a week. Provides a supervised in-depth generalist social work practice experience. The goal of this practicum is to prepare students for self-directed professional social work practice. Students apply theories and concepts from course work to develop generalist social work skills in direct practice with individuals, families, groups, communities, and organizations. No graduate credit. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: SOCW 461; concurrent registration in SOCW 471.
